english.title: Contravene a temporary local traffic prohibition / restriction other than speeding
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[user of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[rider of a pedal cycle]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION..), contravened a temporary local traffic prohibition or restriction order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL ORDER AND NO..), made under section 14 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984, in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above local traffic order and section 16 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
